boundaries: The Dashboard-to-Places target is a declared HTTP boundary; compiler linkage and runtime routing are not established.
HTTP 202 QUEUED does not prove that a forecast refresh ran, completed, or was delivered to either consumer.
These wrappers do not establish idempotency or deduplication across repeated refresh requests.

failures.text: Dashboard maps an exception from fetch or response JSON parsing to 503 with PLACES_UNAVAILABLE; this handler does not reveal whether Places completed or queued the request before that error.
The Places wrapper returns 404 before enqueue when the lookup yields no city.

guarantees.text: The source shows no idempotency key or repeated-request deduplication in these wrappers; behavior beyond the boundary is unresolved.
HTTP 202 conveys QUEUED in this response body, not readiness or completion of the forecast.

operation.text: Dashboard sends POST /places/{id}/refresh to the declared Places.Refresh target.

request.text: Dashboard URL-encodes request.params.id into the path and sends POST without a request body. The wrapper shows no idempotency key.
Places receives the path id and cancellation token; it looks up the place before enqueue.

response.text: If no place is found, Places returns 404 with PLACE_NOT_FOUND and does not reach the enqueue call.
If the place is found, Places awaits repository.Enqueue and returns 202 with placeId and status QUEUED; that status does not establish forecast completion.
Dashboard forwards the upstream status and parsed JSON response.

steps.text: Return Accepted with placeId and status QUEUED. This response does not mean the forecast is ready.

children.text: Find the place. Return 404 if absent; otherwise await repository.Enqueue and return 202 with status QUEUED. The wrapper does not establish downstream forecast completion.

request.text: Dashboard serializes request.body as JSON and sets content-type to application/json. The body schema is not established by these two handler bodies.

response.text: For a supported mapped city, Places awaits repository.Save and then returns 200 with the city. The repository effect is not proven by the controller wrapper.
Dashboard forwards the upstream status and JSON body after parsing the response.
